tools.name: list_receipt_files
tools.description: List receipt-like files (pdf/jpg/png/heic/webp/txt/md/csv) in the folder that are not yet recorded in the ledger. Text files include a best-guess vendor/date/amount to verify. Call this first, then read each pending file and record it with add_receipt.

folder.description: sub-folder relative to the workspace root; default is the root

tools.name: add_receipt
tools.description: Record one receipt in the ledger (date, vendor, amount). Category is applied from vendor rules when not given. Duplicates (same date+vendor+amount) are refused unless force=true.

source.description: receipt file path, relative to the workspace root

tools.name: set_category_rule
tools.description: Teach a rule: this vendor (or name fragment) maps to a category. Existing receipts with a matching vendor are recategorised.

tools.name: receipts_summary
tools.description: Totals by category and month with the ledger as a table. Pass month (YYYY-MM) to scope to one month.

tools.name: export_ledger
tools.description: Write the ledger (optionally one month) to .receipts/exports/ledger-<month|all>.csv for the accountant.
